distractors: The competitor holding the largest share of a market it has led for years.
The first product to reach a market, which gets to set the terms everyone arriving later has to argue against.
The candidate a panel has formally put forward for a post, whose name now goes to the board for sign-off. The contest is already over by then.
The option a team lands on once the evaluation is finished and the scoring is complete, written into the paper as the recommendation everyone is being asked to approve.

An early favourite that has since slipped behind, still discussed because of the position it used to hold rather than the one it holds now. The word carries the loss with it, and it is rarely said kindly.
